title: Tech Note: 4D Mobile Customize Data display using Locale

historical_commentary.text: This note is a Read Me / setup guide tied entirely to the discontinued 4D Mobile / Wakanda Enterprise stack (requiring a separate Wakanda Enterprise license and Wakanda Studio); the locale-based formatting concept it teaches is timeless, but the specific product, licensing, and tooling described no longer exist in current 4D, making the note obsolete as a practical how-to.
related_updates: 4D Mobile and the Wakanda platform have been fully discontinued
Locale-aware date/time/number formatting is now handled via standard 4D/ORDA commands or client-side JS frameworks rather than Wakanda-specific model.js customization
